Peak a short update for new travelers
With that in mind
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers must review pet check-in steps before arrival, because our desk is handling a high volume of companion animal cases today.

Aurelia Skyways is keeping routine checks in place for every animal accepted for travel. Please make sure carriers are secure, labels are clear, and care notes are ready for the team. The cabin team continues to monitor animals during flight and will report any concern through standard channels without delay.

If your plans change, or if your pet shows signs of stress, notify the desk at once so we can adjust handling as needed. For guidance, documents, and live support, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
